claims: Artemis 1 launched from Launch Complex 39B at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
Artemis 1 lifted off at 1:47 a.m. EST.
Artemis 1 lifted off atop the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis 1 was launched to begin its journey around the Moon.
Artemis 1 used the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and Orion spacecraft.
Artemis 1 was the first integrated flight test of NASA's deep space exploration systems
